test_title: RRB Technician Grade III Official Paper (Held On: 28 Dec, 2024 Shift 3)
subject: general
question: A dealer buys three varieties of apples at Rs. 50, Rs. 40 and Rs. 30 per kilogram respectively. He mixes them in the ratio 2 : 4 : 9 respectively. by weight, and sells them at a profit of 30%. At what approximate price (per kilogram) does he sell the mixed variety of apples?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Ratio of weights = 2 : 4 : 9. Total weight = 2 + 4 + 9 = 15 kg.

Weighted average CP = (2 × 50 + 4 × 40 + 9 × 30) ÷ 15 = (100 + 160 + 270) ÷ 15 = 530 ÷ 15 = Rs. 35.33.

SP = Average CP × (100 + P%) ÷ 100 = 35.33 × 1.30 = Rs. 45.93.

Approximate **Selling Price** is Rs. 45.90.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 45.90.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

Given → CP₁ = Rs. 50, CP₂ = Rs. 40, CP₃ = Rs. 30 | Ratio = 2 : 4 : 9 | Profit = 30%.
Formulas: Average CP = Total CP ÷ Total Weight | SP = CP × (100 + Profit%) ÷ 100.
 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/57cfb1d22f331eae0e2a72e597ef9462431cb6585b1d875059c3b64dedc0eb13.png] 
⇒ Total Cost Price = (2 × 50) + (4 × 40) + (9 × 30) = 100 + 160 + 270 = Rs. 530.
⇒ Total Weight = 2 + 4 + 9 = 15 kg.
⇒ Cost Price per kg = 530 ÷ 15 = Rs. 35.333.
⇒ Selling Price per kg = 35.333 × (130 ÷ 100) = 35.333 × 1.3 = Rs. 45.933.
⇒ The closest approximate value from options is Rs. 45.90.

**∴ The correct answer is Rs. 45.90.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Weighted Average Cost Price

When items of different costs are mixed, the average cost is calculated as (Sum of Price × Quantity) ÷ (Total Quantity).

Profit Calculation

Selling Price (SP) is always calculated on the **Cost Price (CP)** using the formula: SP = CP × (1 + Profit/100).</p
